![Translations](/images/translations/japanese-translation.webp)

Hi, my name is yutaro. I’m so inspired by Bitcoin & Nostr based projects that I start this “English to Japanese translations” service which is my strength. So, please feel free to contact me for my help!

[Support my project here (Geyser)](https://geyser.fund/project/japanese)

## Contact

- Nostr: [yutaro@blogstr.net](https://blogstr.net/en/p/yutaro@blogstr.net)
- X: [yutaro21jp](https://x.com/yutaro21jp)

## My translations

### Minister of Tourism of El Salvador

<YouTube id="obw_UB3ApX4" />

I contributed the Japanese subtitles for the congratulatory video by the Minister of Tourism of El Salvador for “Bitcoin Tokyo 2024” presented by ”CUBO+ Travel“. I’m very honored!

### Blink Wallet (Lightning App)

<img
  className="translation-image"
  src="/images/translations/blink-wallet.webp"
  alt="Blink Wallet"
  width="400"
/>

I translated “[Blink Wallet](https://stacksatsjp.substack.com/p/blink)”, a mobile app for lightning payments, into Japanese. It is the beautiful lightning wallet recommended for beginners (formerly “Bitcoin Beach Wallet” in El Salvador).

### Geyser (Crowdfunding Site)

![Geyser](/images/translations/geyser.webp)

I translated the world’s first Bitcoin crowdfunding site, “[Geyser](https://geyser.fund/) (by [Metamick](https://primal.net/p/npub13v9zh6hka0heyh5w0ru0ptdyrauf3wx6w25fwxufnz9l0ptax60sg63rka))”, into Japanese. Of course, I am also looking for funding for this “Japanese translation project” on Geyser.

### CUBO+ Travel (Travel Service)

![CUBO+](/images/translations/CUBO+.webp)

CUBO+, a community that promotes bitcoin education in El Salvador, has recently launched its official travel website, “CUBO+ Travel”, translated into Japanese by me. I would love to travel to El Salvador using this service!

### Nostr Documentary (YouTube)

<YouTube id="aA-jiiepOrE" />

I contributed Japanese subtitles for Nostr’s first documentary video “Social Media is broken. Can we fix it? (by [Max DeMarco](https://primal.net/p/npub1lelkh3hhxw9hdwlcpk6q9t0xt9f7yze0y0nxazvzqjmre3p98x3sthkvyz))” It is an excellent film with interviews with Jack Dorsey and other people fascinated by Nostr.

### Nostr: The Dawn of Cyberspace

![The Dawn of Cyberspace](/images/translations/the-dawn-of-cyberspace.webp)

I was in charge of Japanese translation for the excellent long article “[Nostr: The Dawn of Cyberspace](https://yakihonne.com/article/naddr1qq257w2t8qeksc6tdg6njnekdc6x55j0w56nvq3qarkn0xxxll4llgy9qxkrncn3vc4l69s0dz8ef3zadykcwe7ax3dqxpqqqp65wu2llgg) (by [arkinox](https://primal.net/p/npub1arkn0xxxll4llgy9qxkrncn3vc4l69s0dz8ef3zadykcwe7ax3dqrrh43w))”, which describes the Nostr cyberspace enabled by permissionless and thermodynamics. It is a very thought-provoking and interesting piece, so I would really recommend you read it.

### Bitcoin Beach Project (El Salvador)

![Bitcoin Beach Project ](/images/translations/bitcoin-beach-wallet.webp)

I translated the full text of “[Bitcoin Banking for Communities: Lessons Learned from Bitcoin Beach](https://stacksatsjp.substack.com/p/bitcoin-beach-history)”, a long article summarizing Bitcoin Beach Wallet (now [Blink Wallet](https://primal.net/p/npub13ljnkd633c7maxatymv3y2fqq8vt3qk7j3tt0vytv90eztwgha9qmfcfhw)) lessons learned in El Salvador, into Japanese.

### Nostr.how (Nostr Guide)

![Nostr.how](/images/translations/nostr.how.webp)

I was in charge of the Japanese translation of “[Nostr.how](https://nostr.how/ja/what-is-nostr)“, a detailed explanation of the decentralized social media Nostr. It is a very nice media that even beginners can learn the technical structure of Nostr and its apps.

### Lost in Bitcoin (Media)

![Lost in Bitcoin](/images/translations/lugano-planb.webp)

I was assigned to translate the full text of “[The State of Bitcoin Adoption in Lugano – December 2022](https://lostinbitcoin.jp/lightning/the_state_of_bitcoin_adoption_in_lugano_december_2022/)” into Japanese for “Lost in Bitcoin (by [Teruko](https://primal.net/p/npub19x0h8jm3mnwzhv4tpq62zta05er0qlyge73m0pwsp7h666khkd9qev2ree))“, one of Japan’s largest online bitcoin media. The accuracy and speed of my translation was highly praised, thankfully I will continue to be involved as an English to Japanese translator.

### Nostrasia Registration Form

![Nostrasia Registration Form](/images/translations/nostrasia-survey.webp)

I translated the registration form into Japanese for “[Nostrasia](https://primal.net/p/npub1nstrcu63lzpjkz94djajuz2evrgu2psd66cwgc0gz0c0qazezx0q9urg5l) (2nd Nostr Unconference)” to be held on November 1-3, 2023. The event closed with great success!

### Nostrasia Posters

![Nostrasia Posters](/images/translations/nogood.webp)

I was involved in translating “the poster for Nostrasia (by [NoGood](https://primal.net/p/npub12hcytyr8fumy3axde8wgeced523gyp6v6zczqktwuqeaztfc2xzsz3rdp4))” into Japanese. Please visit Nostrasia to see how this poster is displayed there.

### Habla.news

![Habla.news](/images/translations/habla.news.webp)

I supported “[Habla.news](https://habla.news/jp) (by [verbiricha](https://primal.net/p/npub107jk7htfv243u0x5ynn43scq9wrxtaasmrwwa8lfu2ydwag6cx2quqncxg))” translation into Japanese, which allows you to write long articles on Nostr. If you want to start a blog in a world of free speech, you should give it a try.

### Nos Social (Nostr App)

<img
  className="translation-image"
  src="/images/translations/nos-social.webp"
  alt="Nos Social"
  width="400"
/>

I translated one of the most famous Nostr’s mobile client app, “[Nos Social](https://www.nos.social/)(by [rabble](https://primal.net/p/npub1wmr34t36fy03m8hvgl96zl3znndyzyaqhwmwdtshwmtkg03fetaqhjg240))”, into Japanese. Welcome to the new world of social media that you must try.
